remarks:
Welcome Home to this Beautiful Center Entrance Cape conveniently located close to Lincoln Park! Step inside this charming property where comfort, flexibility, and thoughtful updates come together. The first floor offers the option to live as a ranch, with two bedrooms and a full bath on the main level. The eat-in kitchen has been refreshed with new quartz counters, a coordinating backsplash, and the appliances are included. Large living room and the seller believes there is hardwood flooring beneath the carpet. Two hall closets provide additional storage and the washer / dryer are also included. Updated windows throughout bring in natural light and add efficiency. Central A/C with a humidifier keeps the home comfortable in every season. Upstairs, the third bedroom features two huge closets, and a bonus room provides the perfect spot for a nursery, home office, or family room. Both rooms and stairs have new carpet. A mini split added in 2025 creates an additional heating / cooling zone for the second floor, keeping the upper level comfortable year-round. The dry basement with a poured concrete foundation is ideal for additional living space, whether you dream of a play room, gym, or home theater. Outside, unwind on the covered patio overlooking the large, fully fenced yard, a great setup for pets, play, gardening, or entertaining.
Don't let this move-in ready home pass you by!
